=== platform/flux-system/flux-system-kustomization-monitoring.yaml ===
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: monitoring
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  dependsOn:
  - name: shop
  - name: shop-db
  - name: external
  interval: 1h0m0s
  path: platform/ops/monitoring
  prune: false
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
    namespace: flux-system
=== platform/flux-system/flux-system-kustomization-platform.yaml ===
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: platform
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 1h0m0s
  path: platform/platform
  prune: false
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
    namespace: flux-system
=== platform/flux-system/flux-system-kustomization-shop-api.yaml ===
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: shop-api
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  dependsOn:
  - name: shop-db
  interval: 1h0m0s
  path: platform/apps/shop/shop-api
  prune: false
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
    namespace: flux-system
=== platform/flux-system/flux-system-kustomization-shop-db.yaml ===
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: shop-db
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 1h0m0s
  path: platform/apps/shop/shop-db
  prune: false
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
    namespace: flux-system
=== platform/flux-system/flux-system-kustomization-shop.yaml ===
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: shop
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  healthChecks:
  - apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
    kind: Kustomization
    name: shop-db
    namespace: flux-system
  - apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
    kind: Kustomization
    name: shop-api
    namespace: flux-system
  interval: 1h0m0s
  path: platform/apps/shop
  prune: false
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: flux-system
    namespace: flux-system
=== platform/flux-system/kustomization.yaml ===
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - flux-system-kustomization-monitoring.yaml
  - flux-system-kustomization-platform.yaml
  - flux-system-kustomization-shop-api.yaml
  - flux-system-kustomization-shop-db.yaml
  - flux-system-kustomization-shop.yaml
